- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Bell Zephyr is a popular high-end road bike helmet known for its excellent ventilation, comfort, and sleek design.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Bell Zephyr features Bell's proprietary "Overbrow Ventilation" system for exceptional airflow and cooling.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The helmet has a comfortable, ergonomic design with soft, sweat-wicking interior padding and an adjustable fit system called "Float Fit."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Zephyr meets or exceeds all relevant safety standards, including CPSC, Snell, and CE certifications.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Zephyr weighs around 260-280 grams (depending on the size).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Other notable features of the Bell Zephyr include integrated reflectivity, removable and washable interior padding, and a sleek aerodynamic design.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Bell Zephyr is an excellent choice for commuting if the user rides in warm weather, values a comfortable fit, wants a safe and stylish helmet, and needs a lightweight option.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The typical price range for the Bell Zephyr is $150-$250.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, the Bell Zephyr is well-suited for commuting, recreational riding, or competitive cycling.
